text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a species distribution modeling study focusing on predicting future ranges of three East Asian Cerris oak species under climate change, land use and land cover change (LULC), and dispersal limitations. Although LULC data are incorporated as predictors and their effects on habitat fragmentation are analyzed, the primary research focus is ecological/species distribution rather than on LULC prediction or simulation itself. The study does not implement or develop ≥2 future LULC scenarios with quantitative spatial LULC projections as a central research question. Instead, it uses existing LULC scenario data as inputs. The scale is national (China), but the LULC component serves as an environmental variable, not the main object of prediction. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criterion of primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation.)
